name: Wiz — Cloud Resources
description: Pull cloud asset inventory from Wiz (VMs, containers, serverless, k8s, storage) with cloud provider, region, account, and tags

body.query: query CloudResources($first: Int, $after: String, $filterBy: CloudResourceFilters) { cloudResources(first: $first, after: $after, filterBy: $filterBy) { nodes { id name type nativeType region cloudPlatform providerUniqueId firstSeen lastSeen status cloudAccount { id name externalId } subscription { id name externalId } resourceGroupExternalId tags { key value } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } totalCount } }

validation_request.error_message: Could not authenticate with Wiz. Check your service account credentials.

transform.expr: {'display_name': record.get('name', ''), 'cloud_provider': record.get('cloudPlatform', ''), 'region': record.get('region', ''), 'instance_id': record.get('providerUniqueId', '') or value, 'native_type': record.get('nativeType', '')}

{'native_type': record.get('nativeType', ''), 'cloud_provider': record.get('cloudPlatform', ''), 'cloud_region': record.get('region', ''), 'status': record.get('status', ''), 'provider_unique_id': record.get('providerUniqueId', ''), 'cloud_account_id': (record.get('cloudAccount') or {}).get('externalId', ''), 'cloud_account_name': (record.get('cloudAccount') or {}).get('name', ''), 'subscription_id': (record.get('subscription') or {}).get('externalId', ''), 'subscription_name': (record.get('subscription') or {}).get('name', ''), 'resource_group': record.get('resourceGroupExternalId', ''), 'wiz_type': record.get('type', '')}
[(t or {}).get('key', '') + ':' + (t or {}).get('value', '') for t in (value or []) if isinstance(t, dict)]

resource_types.description: Wiz resource types to pull (e.g., VIRTUAL_MACHINE, CONTAINER, SERVERLESS). Empty = all.
